item.title: The Sea at the Bottom of This Page
item.description:
You probably came here from the “how?” next to the record at the bottom of the page. This is what that sea is.

It’s an oil painting that nobody held a brush for. I drew a simple scene, a small program painted it stroke by stroke (curved strokes, bristles, a bit of impasto, linen underneath), and on the page only the water moves, band by band.

item.title: A Portrait That Listens to My Spotify and Judges Your Browser
item.description:
If you open the home page now, the portrait doesn’t just sit there anymore. It says hi, dresses up for whatever I’m listening to, takes a good look at you and tells you what it thinks, then does the Omarchy bit it always did. Every couple of seconds, by itself.

A made-up visit: someone in Germany, on Windows, at 2 am, while I play arabesk.
